subject: Breakup follow-up: Redwood evaluation — closing the loop
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@zenith.ai>, Alex Johnson <ajohnson@zenith.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood evaluation — quick follow-up + playbook
Attachments: Redwood_Playbook.pdf

Hi Priya / Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through Redwood yesterday — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we covered: hosted API latency profile, Dedicated capacity option for predictable throughput, and our rollout/rollbacks for model versioning.
- Your stated priorities: (1) predictable per-token unit economics, (2) SOC 2 evidence for procurement, (3) timeline for a small pilot (50-100k tokens/week).
- Action items I captured: 
  * Marissa: share the playbook + cost band examples (attached).
  * Priya: confirm procurement contacts & preferred evaluation window.
  * Alex: share any internal security/arch constraints.

If it helps, I can put together a short mutual action plan (2-3 bullets) for procurement and an estimated cost for the pilot by EOD Friday. Are you available for a 15-min sync next week to lock dates? 

Thanks — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Redwood_Playbook.pdf (attached) - 6 pages: pilot checklist, cost bands, recommended rollout cadence.

Hi Marissa,

Thanks - the playbook looks useful. We're still coordinating internally. Procurement has a standard questionnaire and they'll need a few items (SOC 2 report, data handling summary). I've attached the procurement questions so you can have them for reference.

Timing: we've pushed the evaluation window slightly later due to an internal priority shift. I'm not expecting sign-off before mid-April, but I'll flag this with procurement and loop you in once I have a point person.

Alex is cc'd here - Alex, any security constraints you want us to flag?

Talk soon,
Priya
Head of Data Platforms
Zenith AI

Hi Priya / Alex -

Just bumping this thread to see whether the procurement timeline changed and whether the pilot is still a priority for mid-April. We can be flexible on start dates, and if helpful I can: 

- Pull together the SOC 2 summary and data handling note for procurement (2-3 bullets).
- Draft a one-page mutual action plan you can share with the procurement team.

If the timing has slipped, no worries - just want to understand cadence so I don't keep pinging. If you'd like, Rishi (cc'd) can jump on a quick call to walk procurement through the evaluation mechanics.

Thanks - let me know what works.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Priya / Alex -

Wanted to close the loop on our Redwood evaluation. I haven't heard back on procurement timing or a pilot date, so I wanted to check one last time before I close the file on our side. Quick options: 

1) Still interested but timeline slipped - tell me a month that works and I'll reopen the thread and set a short plan.
2) Not a fit / deprioritized - no problem, I'll close the file and we can reconnect later.
3) Want a final 15-min call to unblock procurement - we can do that this week.

If I don't hear back by EOD next Wednesday (2027-04-17), I'll assume this is deprioritized and close the file - happy to reopen anytime.

Attached is a lightweight SOW draft (for planning only) to make it easy for procurement to see scope/costs if you decide to move forward.

Thanks for the time so far - wishing you a smooth quarter.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
